title: Object Storage: portfolio threshold
content:
Object Storage portfolio threshold is defined as follows: Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal.

| Contract tier | Portfolio threshold |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | portfolio threshold: 25000 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the portfolio threshold entry is 25000.
